sections.kicker: Prepared for 150K Optik by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: 150K Optik has 141K followers and a strong service story. The brand reads as a price tag.
sections.keep: Your hashtag, #BerawalDariMata. It is a real idea about where good sight begins.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet

pins.why: Once the brand is a number, every competitor can undercut it, and the care in the service disappears.
pins.how: Let the name lead with the idea in your hashtag, and keep price as a fact.
pins.label: Your name
pins.cost: Customers remember the price, not the shop.

pins.what: Free eye checks and 20 minute glasses read as bullet points.
pins.why: Speed and care are the reasons to choose you over the optician next door.
pins.how: Turn these into the brand's story instead of a list.
pins.label: Your service
pins.cost: Your best service sounds like a discount flyer.

pins.what: Ten highlights cover hours, tips, influencers and lens types.
pins.why: With no hierarchy, nothing tells a new visitor what 150K stands for.
pins.how: Cut to the three that tell your story.
pins.label: Your highlights
pins.cost: Visitors leave knowing your hours, not your brand.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at 150K Optik, and you said you want to look like the brand you are. I spent time on your Instagram. Three things stood out.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on 150K Optik's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: Warby Parker, from retail eyewear. It priced low and still built a name people wear with pride.
